# SYNESIS_E160 — Warning

## Description

Unknown field `field_name`.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: the field `field_name` is not declared in the template.
  Use the field name exactly as in the template.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **AlpacaUnknownField**: `block`, `field_name`, `suggestion`
